Protection and comfort for your dog - with the Comfort panty With handy hook and loop closures, breathable mesh material and easy washing at 30 degrees, our protective panties are the ideal solution for an hygienic care of your four-legged friend. The protective panty is perfect for incontinent dogs and female dogs in heat to reliably protect them while providing maximum comfort. The panties are easy to put on without having to pull your dog's tail through. The lightweight material also provides good ventilation and keeps your dog nice and cool. Sizes XS to XL fit any breed of dog, and the elastic waist belt is continuously adjustable to ensure the perfect fit. The mesh insert allows for good moisture absorption, and you get 3 changeable inserts with it.
